RootTable.Filter: SELECT t_diagram.ea_guid as CLASSGUID, 't_diagram' as CLASSTABLE, t_diagram.Diagram_Type as CLASSTYPE, COALESCE(obj."name", obj.alias, obj.note) as "Object name", obj.object_type as "Obj Type", t_diagram."name" as "Diagram name", t_diagram.Diagram_Type as "Diagram type", t_diagram.[Version], t_diagram.ModifiedDate, t_diagram.CreatedDate, t_diagram.Author FROM t_object obj JOIN t_diagramobjects on t_diagramobjects.object_id = obj.object_id JOIN t_diagram on t_diagram.diagram_id = t_diagramobjects.diagram_id WHERE obj."name" LIKE '#WC#<Search Term>#WC#' or obj.alias LIKE '#WC#<Search Term>#WC#' or obj.note LIKE '#WC#<Search Term>#WC#';

SELECT t_diagram.ea_guid as CLASSGUID, 't_diagram' as CLASSTABLE, t_diagram.Diagram_Type as CLASSTYPE, COALESCE(conn."name", conn.notes) as "Connector", t_diagram."name" as "Diagram name", t_diagram.Diagram_Type as "Diagram type", t_diagram.[Version], t_diagram.ModifiedDate, t_diagram.CreatedDate, t_diagram.Author FROM t_connector conn JOIN t_diagram ON t_diagram.diagram_id = conn.diagramid WHERE conn."name" LIKE '#WC#<Search Term>#WC#' or conn.notes LIKE '#WC#<Search Term>#WC#';
